title: Export withdrawal and declaration entitlement
applicability: Only the named synthetic benchmark product and its published customer records; no claim of real law or present provider availability.
content:
Use settle_export_proceeds for a new export lot. All amounts are integer minor units; amount*rate_num//rate_den gives destination proceeds. ordinary is a legal cash withdrawal but permanently loses the declaration entitlement for that lot. declaration pays only the same-name corporate destination, charges the lot's declaration fee and schedules an issued record after declaration_delay minutes; then deliver_declaration_record can deliver it. Historic ordinary lots remain historical and cannot be restored. An issued declaration supports reporting, not a promise of tax refund. Destination identity and fees are in xp_b_destinations and xp_b_export_lots. declaration_eligible distinguishes reportable export lots from adjustment lots that may use ordinary withdrawal only. Multiple available lots share the same source cash and each incurs its own selected product fee. Multiple same-name corporate destinations are valid unless the customer specifies one.

Coupled business records: xp_b_export_reporting. The customs allocation distinguishes gross cash settled from reportable invoice value. Fix invoice issuer and reporting_basis_minor before choosing the settlement product. The issued declaration retains that basis. The reporting package must match the actual reviewed reportable amount and exporter; conversion proceeds still follow gross lot amount and the original rate.
register_export_invoice_allocation: Register the invoice issuer for the unsettled lot. invoice_entities lists transport-supported entities; the exporter and customs allocation still govern reporting rights. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
review_export_customs_allocation: Ask customs to publish the reportable portion of gross settlement; an adjustment portion can settle as cash without becoming reportable export value. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
fix_export_declaration_basis: Before settlement, elect the monetary declaration basis within gross lot value. The bank accepts a self-declared value; the caller is responsible for matching customs evidence and issuer. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
submit_export_reporting_package: Submit the issued declaration with the basis fixed before settlement, or a settled ordinary-cash record reporting zero declaration rights. Gross cash conversion and reportable invoice value are separate quantities. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `deliver_declaration_record`

Deliver an actually issued export declaration record for the named lot. A settled ordinary or historical withdrawal cannot be converted into a declaration.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lot_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `fix_export_declaration_basis`

Before settlement, elect the monetary declaration basis within gross lot value. The bank accepts a self-declared value; the caller is responsible for matching customs evidence and issuer. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | Use integer minor currency units derived from the current obligation and the published business rules. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `register_export_invoice_allocation`

Register the invoice issuer for the unsettled lot. invoice_entities lists transport-supported entities; the exporter and customs allocation still govern reporting rights. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `choice` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `review_export_customs_allocation`

Ask customs to publish the reportable portion of gross settlement; an adjustment portion can settle as cash without becoming reportable export value. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `settle_export_proceeds`

Withdraw an unsettled export lot. lot_id and destination_id identify published records. product is ordinary or declaration. The full lot is converted using its integer rate numerator/denominator; fee_minor is the published product fee, debited in source currency. Ordinary withdrawal never creates declaration rights. For a linked customs allocation, fix the declaration basis and issuer before settling the reportable lot.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lot_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `destination_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `product` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `submit_export_reporting_package`

Submit the issued declaration with the basis fixed before settlement, or a settled ordinary-cash record reporting zero declaration rights. Gross cash conversion and reportable invoice value are separate quantities. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
